add_parcel.title: Add parcel
add_parcel.description: Enter a tracking number from Posten/Bring or Helthjem. Global settings (language, delivery contexts) are configured via the Settings entry.

global.title: Global settings
global.description: Configure language and delivery context thresholds. These settings apply to all tracked parcels and can be changed later from the Settings entry.

data.default_notify_all_events: Default: notify on all tracking events
data.default_notify_delivered: Default: notify when parcel is delivered
data.default_create_calendar_event: Default: create calendar event for estimated delivery
data.default_stale_warning_hours: Default warning threshold — hours without movement
data.default_stale_critical_hours: Default critical threshold — hours without movement

data_description.language: Norwegian shows Posten's original text. English translates statuses and events to English.
data_description.mailbox_enabled: When enabled, the status sensor reports whether the parcel fits through your mailbox slot.
data_description.car_enabled: When enabled, the status sensor reports whether the parcel fits in your car boot.
data_description.carry_enabled: When enabled, the status sensor reports whether the parcel is small enough to carry by hand.
data_description.auto_delete_delivered_hours: When set to a non-zero value, the integration will automatically remove a parcel entry this many hours after it is first detected as delivered. Set to 0 to keep delivered parcels forever.

email_watcher.title: Set up email watcher
email_watcher.description: Connect an IMAP mailbox. The integration will scan for order confirmation emails and automatically add recognised tracking numbers. Use an app password (not your regular account password) for Gmail and Microsoft accounts.

data.email_days_back: Scan emails from the last N days

data_description.email_server: Your mail provider's IMAP server. Examples: imap.gmail.com, outlook.office365.com.
data_description.email_password: For Gmail and Microsoft accounts, create an app password — your normal account password will not work with IMAP.
data_description.email_folder: The mailbox folder to scan. Leave as INBOX to scan your inbox.
data_description.email_poll_interval_minutes: How often to check for new emails. 15 minutes is a good default.
data_description.email_days_back: On first start, emails this many days back are scanned. Subsequent polls only look at new emails.

error.cannot_connect: Could not fetch tracking data from Posten/Bring
error.helthjem_cannot_connect: Could not fetch tracking data from Helthjem
error.unsupported_tracking_number: Invalid or unsupported tracking number. This integration only supports Bring, Helthjem, and Posten. Support for more delivery companies is planned and coming in the near future.
error.cannot_connect_imap: Could not connect to the IMAP server. Check the server address and port.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your username and password (use an app password for Gmail/Microsoft).
error.email_folder_not_found: Could not open the mailbox folder. Check the folder name (usually INBOX).
